aerodactyl-stone-edge.name: Stone Edge
aerodactyl-stone-edge.description: Bond skill: sharp stones at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85, Attack); Exposed 1 turn.

aerodactyl-aerial-ace.name: Aerial Ace
aerodactyl-aerial-ace.description: Bond skill: swoops up to 2 hexes onto a foe (Power 60, Attack) and engages it.

aerodactyl-wide-guard.name: Wide Guard
aerodactyl-wide-guard.description: Bond skill: spreads its wings over itself and adjacent allies: Fortified for 2 turns.

aerodactyl-tough-claws.name: Tough Claws
aerodactyl-tough-claws.description: Deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes.

aerodactyl-fossil-hide.name: Fossil Hide
aerodactyl-fossil-hide.description: Its stony ancient hide: takes 10% less damage.

aerodactyl-rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
aerodactyl-rock-slide.description: New skill: hurls boulders at a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 55).

aerodactyl-roar.name: Roar
aerodactyl-roar.description: New skill: a primeval roar that drives an adjacent foe 2 hexes back.

aerodactyl-ambush-dive.name: Ambush Dive
aerodactyl-ambush-dive.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

aerodactyl-jagged-hide.name: Jagged Hide
aerodactyl-jagged-hide.description: Its jagged stone hide deals 6 damage to foes that hit it from an adjacent hex.

aerodactyl-crunch.name: Crunch
aerodactyl-crunch.description: New skill: crushing fangs (Power 75) that leave the foe Exposed for 1 turn.

aerodactyl-tailwind.name: Tailwind
aerodactyl-tailwind.description: New skill: a gale from its wings: itself and allies within 2 hexes are Hasted for 2 turns.

aerodactyl-skyborne.name: Skyborne
aerodactyl-skyborne.description: Lifts off from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

aerodactyl-apex-predator.name: Apex Predator
aerodactyl-apex-predator.description: Gains 1 Attack (max 3) each time it knocks out a foe.

aerodactyl-iron-head.name: Iron Head
aerodactyl-iron-head.description: New skill: rams with its steel-hard skull (Power 75).

aerodactyl-scary-face.name: Scary Face
aerodactyl-scary-face.description: New skill: a terrifying glare at a foe up to 2 hexes away: Slowed for 2 turns.

aerodactyl-living-fossil.name: Living Fossil
aerodactyl-living-fossil.description: Outlasted the ages: survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

aerodactyl-high-vantage.name: High Vantage
aerodactyl-high-vantage.description: Strikes from above: its ranged moves fire over Pokémon in the way.

aerodactyl-sky-attack.name: Sky Attack
aerodactyl-sky-attack.description: New skill: a plummeting strike on a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

aerodactyl-rock-tomb.name: Rock Tomb
aerodactyl-rock-tomb.description: New skill: boulders on a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 55) that Slow it for 2 turns.

aerodactyl-pursuit-instinct.name: Crushing Jaws
aerodactyl-pursuit-instinct.description: Deals 20% more damage to Exposed foes.

aerodactyl-skyward-momentum.name: Skyward Momentum
aerodactyl-skyward-momentum.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

aerodactyl-ancient-terror.name: Ancient Terror
aerodactyl-ancient-terror.description: Capstone. A knockout lets it use its basic attack again and heals it 15% of max HP.

aerodactyl-ruler-of-the-skies.name: Pressure
aerodactyl-ruler-of-the-skies.description: Capstone. Foes it engages take 20% more damage from its allies and always draw its free strike when leaving.
